request.system:
Two issue records from the same construction project. Decide whether they describe the same underlying issue: the same problem or dependency, possibly worded differently or at a later stage (for example an unconfirmed date that is later confirmed late is the same issue).
Return JSON {"same": true|false, "reason": "<at most 20 words>"}.
request.user:
Earlier issue (first seen 2025-07-04): Risk of further programme slip. A 14-day slip takes the delivery start date into the capacity market window with no spare time, exposing the project to risk if further delays occur.
New mention (2025-07-11): Capacity market delivery start risk. The forecast energisation date of 28/11/2025 leaves only three days before the capacity market delivery start date of 01/12/2025. Any further slip risks the delivery start.

response.reason: Both address risk of delivery start date conflicting with capacity market window.
